feeding_claim.verbatim: Unless otherwise requested, our beef are finished on our farm fro 90-120 days of a free feeding corn and grass mixture.

notes: Fifth-generation ranching family in the Sulphur Springs Valley who also do custom processing; site says they handle ranching, farming and processing within the family. Default finish is 90 to 120 days on a corn and grass mix; the homepage meta text says grass or grain finished, and the FAQ says unless otherwise requested, so a grass-finished option may exist but is not described; category kept cautious. Whole $7.25, half $7.50, quarter $7.75 per lb including processing, $150 deposit. Owner delivers in their own vehicle, $75 standard fee varying by distance; site mentions serving all of Southern Arizona but names no towns. No shipping or pickup stated. Tallow sold through an outside store (raise-wellness.com).
